name: Bridger: WESTERN
desc:
Mankind in their expansion west have settled within Ridge. B Valley, a grueling and untouched wilderness rumored to hold an ancient curse. Beasts hunt and forces beyond mortal reach skulk these grounds, their chaos trapped and anchored by those who came long before them.

Your place within the valley is yet to be decided,  whatever path you choose to walk down danger remains a constant.

-Basic Controls-
Q - Quick dash 
W+W - Sprint 
R - Reload (With Weapon)
M1 - Fire (With weapon)
M2 - Aim in (With weapon) 
G - Melee (With weapon)
X - Ocular Prowess 
C - Fists 
F - Block (With fists out)
M - Statistics Menu 
H - Summon/Unsummon horse
N - Ride horse/Dismount

MAKE SURE TO HAVE A CLIPPING SOFTWARE SUCH AS MEDAL, SHADOWPLAY ETC IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO BE UNBANNED FROM ANTICHEAT.
(This game is in Early Alpha, meaning that everything is work in progress, and subject to change.)

Some clothing in game is made by Blotnik

llm.loop: explore a cursed western valley -> fight beasts and players with guns, fists and a special ability -> fish, gather and store loot -> reroll stands/traits to get stronger
llm.objectives: survive and choose your own path in a dangerous open-world frontier
llm.progression: unclear; stats menu, stand/ability rerolls, horse, storage
llm.instructions: lore intro plus keybinds for dash, sprint, guns, melee, blocking, Ocular Prowess ability and horse riding; keep clipping software for anticheat appeals
unique: western frontier combined with JoJo-style stands and supernatural curse
llm.thumbnails: stylised hand-drawn/manga art of characters and western scenes; no gameplay or numbers shown
llm.complexity_notes: open world map, horses, gun and melee combat systems, abilities, anticheat; early alpha
